description: Run ML.PREDICT / ML.FORECAST / ML.EXPLAIN_PREDICT / ML.DETECT_ANOMALIES against a BQML model and return a DataFrame.

operation.label: Operation
operation.description: One of: predict / forecast / explain_predict / detect_anomalies.

input_query.description: Inline SELECT producing the input rows. For ML.FORECAST set horizon-style options instead via `options` and leave this null.
input_query.label: Input Query

input_table_id.description: Fully-qualified table id whose rows are passed as input. Mutually exclusive with input_query.
input_table_id.label: Input Table ID

options.description: Options struct passed to ML.PREDICT/ML.FORECAST/etc. Example for forecast: {horizon: 10, confidence_level: 0.95}.
options.label: Options

threshold.description: For LOGISTIC_REG / DNN_CLASSIFIER / boosted-tree classifiers — set the score threshold.
threshold.label: Threshold

keep_input_columns.description: If True (default), prediction output preserves all input columns alongside the predicted ones.
keep_input_columns.label: Keep Input Columns

upstream_asset_key.description: Optional Dagster lineage hook. Doesn't affect input rows — set input_query or input_table_id for those.
upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key

deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime).
deps.label: Deps

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before this asset is considered stale.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron Schedule

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

name: BigQuery ML Predict
